crossRefs.note: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work…
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

translations.web: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
translations.bsb: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
translations.kjv: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
translations.asv: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.
